convertibility_reason: Uses built-in MT5 indicators only (iMA, iATR). Simple candlestick pattern entry with fixed SL/TP and ATR-based options. No external .mqh libraries. Standard position sizing.

other_exits: Manual SL/TP set on order entry, no dynamic exit logic

custom_logic_notes: Evening Star is a 3-candle bearish reversal pattern: (1) large bullish candle, (2) small-bodied candle (star) with a gap up, (3) bearish candle closing below midpoint of first candle body. The pattern is validated only on completed bars (shift 1,2,3). An optional trend filter using 200 SMA requires price to be below the MA for additional confirmation. SL/TP can be either fixed pip values or ATR-based multiples selected via input boolean. Digit adjustment (_Digits==5 || _Point<0.001 multiply by 10) is applied to fixed SL/TP pip values.
python_conversion_notes: Evening Star pattern detection uses OHLC comparisons on 3 consecutive completed bars. Translate candle body calculations as abs(open-close). The star candle requires small body relative to surrounding candles and a gap (star low > first candle high or star open > first candle close). Third candle must close below midpoint of first candle body. Trend filter is a simple price vs SMA comparison. ATR-based SL/TP uses ATR indicator value multiplied by user-input coefficients. Fixed SL/TP values need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10 when point < 0.001).
